question: When and where was the maiden Athletics World Cup organised, that was discontinued after its first edition?
solution:
The correct answer is __**London, 2018.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• On **July 14 and 15, 2018, London**, United Kingdom, hosted the **2018 Athletics World Cup. **
 
• This tournament had one and **only one edition.**
 
• Each team sent o**ne participant **every event.
 
• Teams** received points **based on where they** finished** each event.
 
• No** races longer than 1500 **meters were run, and neither **road events nor multi-events **were scheduled.
 
• The** Platinum Trophy, Platinum team medals, the overall team reward, and team prize money** were the main tournament prizes.
 
• There were** individual gold, silver, and bronze medals** given out for each event.
 
• The **United States** triumphed in the first edition, beating **Poland.**
 
• **Great Britain and Northern Ireland** came in third.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** nineteenth edition** of the World Athletics Championships will take place in** 2023.**
 
• They'll take place in** Budapest, Hungary,** from** August 19** to **August 27, 2023.**
